sources.covers: sensor (Sony IMX392LQR-C), shutter, resolution, sensor format and effective diagonal, pixel size, frame rate, interface, synchronisation, power, C-mount, size, mass

note: A compact colour USB 3.0 machine-vision camera (ace 2 R) with a C-mount. Sold without a lens, so no FOV, f-number or focus is stated: the imager has no FOV and the library uses its labelled default until the user enters the chosen lens (or a calibration). Resolution 1936 x 1216 full, 1920 x 1200 default; 164 fps at default settings. Pixel formats are on a separate page (not read): format null. Power "~3.1 W (typical) @ 5 VDC". Mass "<85 g" (a bound, so mass_g is null). size_mm is the stated 48.1 x 29 x 29 mm "with lens mount and connectors" (36.3 x 29 x 29 mm without), L along the optical axis. Effective sensor diagonal 7.9 mm. One opto-coupled input and two GPIO lines; IP30.
interface: USB 3.0 (SuperSpeed, nominal max. 5 Gbit/s); USB3 Vision

sync.what: General specifications, Synchronization: "Via hardware trigger, Via software trigger, Via free run"; 1 opto-coupled input line.
